description: Coaxial propulsion candidate for the research airframe. Manufacturer tables and design targets only. Nothing here was measured on the built aircraft.

cell_voltage_nominal.source: LiPo nominal cell voltage convention, not a measurement.

cell_voltage_min_operating.source: Lower operating limit assumption. Replace with the pack datasheet limit and the sag measured at hover current.

motor_kv.source: D4215-21 650KV nameplate. Not verified on a dynamometer; KV tolerance and winding differences are not included.

motor_count.source: Coaxial counter-rotating pair, each motor independently driven.

propeller.source: APC multi-rotor series, standard rotation. Paired with 12x4.5MRP for the reverse-rotation position.

loaded_rpm_fraction.source: Loaded speed as a fraction of the no-load KV product. Assumption only; replace with measured RPM from ESC telemetry or an optical tachometer.

coaxial_thrust_loss.source: Momentum theory gives 20.6 percent as the fully interfering upper bound at equal power. Real partially immersed stacks lose less. Replace with a measurement from the protected coaxial stand, recording rotor spacing and what was held constant.

target_mass.source: Design ceiling for the complete flight configuration, decided 2026-09-20. Not a weighed mass.

thrust_to_weight_goal.source: Relaxed from 2.0 on 2026-09-20 to keep the 1.5 kg ceiling with this propulsion set. A design choice for this research airframe, not a general safety standard.

tvc_tilt_limit.source: 15 degrees of mechanical gimbal travel, used to size the vertical thrust component. Initial commanded travel stays at 8 degrees.
